What it does: Creates/updates a field using values from other rows
Important configuration: Num rows, 'Values for rows that don't exist', Group By, new-field type/size
Common mistakes: Forgetting Group By; wrong 'rows that don't exist' value; not sorting first
Exam traps: Given an expression + input, predict every output row incl. the first/last

What it does: Applies one expression to many fields at once
Important configuration: Select fields, 'Copy Output Fields and Add', change type/size, [_CurrentField_]/[_CurrentFieldName_]
Common mistakes: Leaving 'Copy...Add' on when you meant to overwrite; type mismatch across selected fields
Exam traps: Overwrite vs add new fields; result data type

What it does: Creates/overwrites fields with expressions
Important configuration: Function categories; data type of new field; order of expressions (later can use earlier)
Common mistakes: Assuming later fields aren't usable in same tool (they are, in order); wrong type
Exam traps: DateTime()/ToNumber()/Round()/REGEX_*/GetWord()/FindString()/Trim() exact behaviour

What it does: Splits records into True and False by a condition
Important configuration: Basic vs Custom; compound AND/OR with parentheses
Common mistakes: AND/OR precedence without parentheses; using = vs == ; null handling
Exam traps: Which records go to T vs F for a compound expression

What it does: Adds rows by looping an expression
Important configuration: Create new vs update field; Initialization / Condition / Loop expressions; numeric vs date
Common mistakes: Off-by-one on the Condition; infinite loop; wrong field type for dates
Exam traps: How many rows are produced and their values

What it does: Looks up values from a second input and replaces/appends
Important configuration: Find within field; whole vs any part; replace text vs append fields; case
Common mistakes: 'Any part of field' vs 'whole field'; multiple matches; case sensitivity
Exam traps: Result when a term appears 0, 1, many times

What it does: Joins 3+ inputs on key field(s) or position
Important configuration: Join fields per input; Cartesian if none; 'output only records that joined'; field prefixes
Common mistakes: Accidental Cartesian; unmatched records dropped/kept; duplicate field names
Exam traps: Row count and columns after joining N inputs

What it does: Applies a regular expression to one field
Important configuration: Output method Replace / Tokenize / Parse / Match; marked groups; case-insensitive
Common mistakes: Confusing Parse and Match; too few output columns for Tokenize; unescaped metachar
Exam traps: Columns/rows produced by each method for a given pattern

What it does: Correlation / association between a target and other fields
Important configuration: Choose fields; target field; Pearson vs Spearman; p-values
Common mistakes: Reading association for categorical as if continuous; ignoring p-value
Exam traps: Interpret the correlation matrix / measures output

What it does: Profiles each field (missing, unique, distribution)
Important configuration: Select fields to profile
Common mistakes: Assuming it changes the data (it doesn't)
Exam traps: Which stats appear for numeric vs string fields

What it does: Counts occurrences of each distinct value
Important configuration: Select one or more fields
Common mistakes: Expecting cross-tab (use Contingency Table for that)
Exam traps: Counts & % for a small sample incl. nulls

What it does: Linear correlation matrix
Important configuration: Select numeric fields; complete vs pairwise
Common mistakes: Using on non-linear / ordinal data
Exam traps: Sign & rough magnitude for a scatter description

What it does: Rank-based (monotonic) correlation matrix
Important configuration: Select fields
Common mistakes: Thinking it needs linearity (it needs monotonicity)
Exam traps: When Spearman > Pearson and why

What it does: Builds a report table snippet
Important configuration: Per-column config; rule-based formatting; grouping; Basic vs Pivot
Common mistakes: Formatting rule on the wrong column; number format
Exam traps: What the rendered table looks like given rules

What it does: Builds a chart snippet
Important configuration: Layers; chart type; X/Y fields; aggregation; axis/legend
Common mistakes: Wrong aggregation; category vs value axis
Exam traps: Chart shape for a given data + config

What it does: Arranges report snippets into a composite
Important configuration: Vertical/horizontal; per-section orientation; borders/margins; layout per group
Common mistakes: Mixing up section order; forgetting Layout before Render for multi-snippet
Exam traps: Arrangement of snippets for a config

What it does: Converts report snippets to a file/format
Important configuration: Output format (PDF/HTML/DOCX/XLSX/PCXML); paper size; group into separate reports; field vs file
Common mistakes: Rendering without Layout; wrong per-group setting; temp file path
Exam traps: Number of output files / pages for a config

What it does: Sends email per record with optional report attachment
Important configuration: SMTP; To/From/Subject/Body from fields; attachments (report or blob)
Common mistakes: One email per record when you wanted one; SMTP auth
Exam traps: How many emails and their content

What it does: Turns lat/long fields into point spatial objects
Important configuration: X = Longitude, Y = Latitude; CRS
Common mistakes: Swapping X/Y (long/lat) so points land in the ocean
Exam traps: What the spatial object field contains

What it does: Flags/joins Target vs Universe by a spatial relationship
Important configuration: Match condition (Contains/Intersects/Touches/Within); which side is Target
Common mistakes: Reversing Target/Universe; record duplication on multiple matches
Exam traps: Matched vs unmatched counts for overlapping shapes

What it does: Builds rings (radius or drive-time) around points
Important configuration: Ring size(s); miles vs drive-time; overlap Keep/Remove/Cookie-cut
Common mistakes: Overlap handling; combined vs per-centre; drive-time needs data pack
Exam traps: Shape/area of the resulting polygons

What it does: Distance/time between two spatial inputs
Important configuration: Point-point vs point-poly; straight-line vs driving; units; direction
Common mistakes: Expecting driving distance without a dataset; unit confusion
Exam traps: Distance value / which pairs are measured

What it does: Nearest N Universe records to each Target
Important configuration: N nearest; max distance; distance field
Common mistakes: Target/Universe reversed; N too small; max-distance drops rows
Exam traps: Which target keeps which universe rows + distance

What it does: Calls a URL / REST API
Important configuration: Method; Headers; Query/Payload; output to string vs blob; encoding
Common mistakes: POST body in wrong tab; needing blob for binary; rate limits
Exam traps: What DownloadData/Headers contain

What it does: Opens an in-database connection stream
Important configuration: Connection (or DCM); write vs read; query
Common mistakes: Streaming out too early (kills pushdown)
Exam traps: Which operations push down vs pull to Designer

What it does: Moves data between Designer and In-DB
Important configuration: Table name / temp table; append/overwrite/create
Common mistakes: Streaming out mid-pipeline unnecessarily
Exam traps: When data actually leaves the database

What it does: Lists files in a folder
Important configuration: Path; wildcard; include sub-directories; fields returned
Common mistakes: Forgetting the wildcard; sub-directory toggle
Exam traps: Rows/columns returned for a folder

What it does: Reads a file or table
Important configuration: Format options; wildcard multi-file/sheet; record limit; first row; file name as field
Common mistakes: Wildcard schema mismatch; wrong sheet; header option
Exam traps: Rows read for a wildcard + options

What it does: Writes a file or table
Important configuration: File type options; overwrite/append; take file/sheet name from field
Common mistakes: Overwrite vs append; sheet handling; locked file
Exam traps: Files/sheets produced for a config

What it does: Reads many sources using a template
Important configuration: Template file; 'list of data sources' vs 'change entire file path'; Modify SQL action
Common mistakes: Different-schema errors; template mismatch; SQL action syntax
Exam traps: Combined output when schemas differ

What it does: Renames fields programmatically
Important configuration: Method: first row of data / formula / add-remove prefix-suffix / from R input
Common mistakes: 'First row of data' also removes that row; formula scope
Exam traps: Field names after the chosen method

What it does: String/field <-> BLOB
Important configuration: To Blob vs From Blob; field; encoding
Common mistakes: Direction; picking a non-blob field
Exam traps: Field type before/after

What it does: Reads binary files into a BLOB field
Important configuration: Wildcard path; field name
Common mistakes: Large files / memory; pairing with Directory
Exam traps: One row per file; blob field present

What it does: Writes a BLOB field to files
Important configuration: Filename from field; extension
Common mistakes: Missing extension; filename collisions
Exam traps: Files written for N blob rows

What it does: Entry point / template for data into a macro
Important configuration: Template data; field map; 'Show Field Map'; anchor name & abbreviation
Common mistakes: No template so downstream tools can't configure; Show Field Map off
Exam traps: What the macro user sees at configure time

What it does: Exit anchor for data leaving a macro
Important configuration: Anchor name & abbreviation; multiple outputs
Common mistakes: Multiple outputs unlabeled
Exam traps: Which stream maps to which anchor

What it does: Makes a workflow a BATCH macro; drives one run per record
Important configuration: Connect to Action tools; runs macro once per control record
Common mistakes: Expecting it to stream like data; needs an Action to have effect
Exam traps: Number of macro passes = control record count

What it does: Updates a target tool's XML from an Interface/Control value
Important configuration: Update value (default) / with formula / replace specific string / raw XML
Common mistakes: Wrong XML target; 'replace specific string' matching too much
Exam traps: Resulting configuration of the target tool

What it does: Branches the interface/config flow on an expression
Important configuration: Expression; only valid in app/macro
Common mistakes: Thinking it filters data records
Exam traps: Which downstream interface actions fire

What it does: Raises a warning/error when an expression is true
Important configuration: Expression; message text; warning vs error; stops before run
Common mistakes: Assuming records are filtered; warning vs hard stop
Exam traps: Whether the app runs and what the user sees

What it does: Boolean interface question
Important configuration: Value when checked / unchecked; default
Common mistakes: Value strings not matching the Action/Condition
Exam traps: Downstream value emitted

What it does: Single-select interface question
Important configuration: List source (manual/file/connected); Name vs Value
Common mistakes: Confusing display Name with the Value used downstream
Exam traps: Value passed to Action

What it does: Path picker interface question
Important configuration: File filter; returns a path string
Common mistakes: No filter; relative vs absolute path
Exam traps: Path handed to Input/Output via Action

What it does: Multi-select interface question
Important configuration: Delimited string vs field selection; Generate Custom List (prefix/suffix/delimiter)
Common mistakes: Delimiter / quoting for SQL IN lists; empty selection
Exam traps: The exact string generated

What it does: Bounded numeric interface question
Important configuration: Min, Max, Increment, Decimal places
Common mistakes: Range too tight; decimals
Exam traps: Value range the user can submit

What it does: Mutually exclusive interface choice
Important configuration: Each button separate; grouped; default
Common mistakes: Not grouping; needing an Action per button
Exam traps: Which single value is active

What it does: Free text/number interface question
Important configuration: Password; multi-line; numeric
Common mistakes: No validation; multiline delimiters
Exam traps: String fed to Action

What it does: Run-time picker for a DCM connection
Important configuration: Pairs with DCM-enabled tools
Common mistakes: Tool not DCM-enabled; permissions
Exam traps: Which connection the workflow uses

What it does: Releases outputs 1->2->3 only after all records arrive
Important configuration: No config; placement matters
Common mistakes: Placing it where it can't see all records; expecting parallelism
Exam traps: Order of writes vs reads in one workflow

What it does: Runs an external program/script
Important configuration: Command + args; write source; read results; working dir
Common mistakes: Path quoting; blocking; needs a dummy passthrough
Exam traps: Whether/what data returns to the workflow

What it does: Selects fields by type or by formula at run time
Important configuration: By type / by formula; include vs exclude
Common mistakes: Formula returns nothing -> empty stream
Exam traps: Fields kept for a given data set

What it does: Splits one field into rows or columns by a delimiter
Important configuration: Delimiters; split to rows vs columns; extra columns handling
Common mistakes: Delimiter set incl. space; leftover columns
Exam traps: Rows/columns produced

What it does: Group By + aggregations incl. spatial actions
Important configuration: Group By; aggregations; spatial: Combine / Convex Hull / Centroid / Bounding Rectangle
Common mistakes: Wrong aggregation; spatial action location
Exam traps: Aggregated rows / combined spatial object

What it does: Emits messages / warnings / errors during run
Important configuration: When to fire; message type
Common mistakes: Firing per record and flooding the log
Exam traps: Log output

What it does: Reroutes flow in an app based on an interface toggle
Important configuration: Detour direction from interface
Common mistakes: Direction not wired to interface
Exam traps: Which branch runs

What it does: Validates data/config; fails the run on a bad assertion
Important configuration: Test type; expected result
Common mistakes: Not used in build/CI
Exam traps: Pass/fail of the workflow

What it does: Extracts properties (area, centroid, bounds) from a spatial object
Important configuration: Which properties to return
Common mistakes: Units of area/length
Exam traps: Numeric properties returned

What it does: Reorder / rename / retype / deselect fields
Important configuration: Type & size; rename; forget-missing
Common mistakes: Silent type truncation
Exam traps: Schema after Select

What it does: Inner + left + right output on key or position
Important configuration: Join on field vs position; field selection
Common mistakes: Position joins; duplicate keys fan-out
Exam traps: L/J/R row counts

What it does: Stacks multiple inputs
Important configuration: Auto by name vs position; missing fields
Common mistakes: Name vs position; type coercion
Exam traps: Combined schema & row order
